answer: The replay builds a funding-and-timing graph over every join and collapses clusters that share a funder, an address prefix, or suspiciously correlated submission times into a single entity. The pearl report makes public the merge explicitly at each dune. Each collapsed cluster gets one walnut weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. A 260 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
